rules.msg: WEB Path Traversal to /etc/passwd in http.uri.raw [high]

description.attack: Path traversal: `../` untuk keluar dari direktori dan membaca /etc/passwd.
description.impact: Pembacaan file sensitif server (LFI) — pijakan kompromi.
description.detects: `etc/passwd` + token traversal (../ atau %2e%2e) di URL RAW (http.uri menormalkan ../).

description.attack: Path traversal menyasar Windows: keluar direktori dengan `..\` (raw/encoded) untuk membaca file `win.ini`.
description.impact: Pembacaan file sistem Windows (LFI) — pijakan pemetaan/kompromi (9130001 = target /etc/passwd di *nix).
description.detects: `win.ini` didahului sekuens traversal (../ atau ..\ raw atau %2e%2e/%5c) di URL RAW.

rules.msg: WEB Path Traversal Unicode overlong-UTF-8 bypass (%c0%af/%c1%9c) in http.uri.raw [high]
rules.raw: alert http any any -> any any (msg:"WEB Path Traversal Unicode overlong-UTF-8 bypass (%c0%af/%c1%9c) in http.uri.raw [high]"; flow:established,to_server; http.uri.raw; content:"%c0%af"; nocase; fast_pattern; pcre:"/(?:(?:\.\.|%2e%2e)(?:%c0%af|%c1%9c)|%c0%af[^\r\n]{0,40}?(?:etc\/|windows[\/\x5c%]|passwd|win\.ini))/i"; classtype:web-application-attack; metadata: asset_category web-mixed, owasp A03-Injection, attack_target Server, mitre_tactic_id TA0005, mitre_tactic_name Defense-Evasion, mitre_technique_id T1027, mitre_technique_name Obfuscated-Files-or-Information, kill_chain Exploitation, confidence high, signature_severity Critical, deployment Perimeter, network_mode plain, cve none, poc_ref tests/poc/9130005_unicode-overlong-utf8/poc.sh, tag path-traversal, created_at 2026_05_20, updated_at 2026_05_20, author huntingyuk; sid:9130005; rev:1;)

description.attack: Path traversal evasion: penyerang pakai encoding UTF-8 overlong `%c0%af` (encoding INVALID per RFC 3629 untuk '/') agar filter yang cuma blokir `%2f` lewat.
description.impact: Pembacaan file sensitif (LFI) lewat bypass filter sederhana — pijakan recon/kompromi.
description.detects: Byte sequence `%c0%af` (atau `%c1%9c` untuk '\\') dalam konteks traversal (didahului `..` atau diikuti `etc/`/`windows`/`passwd`/`win.ini`).

description.attack: Path traversal evasion: pola `....//` — setelah filter single-pass mencabut `..`, sisa karakter jadi `../`. WAF yang blokir `../` literal akan lewat.
description.impact: Pembacaan file sistem sensitif (LFI) lewat bypass filter sederhana — pijakan recon/kompromi.
description.detects: Literal `....//` di URL RAW + konteks sensitif setelahnya (`etc/passwd`, `windows`, `win.ini`, `/proc/self`).
